notes: The journal submission reviewed by the referees had Figs. 1-2 of arXiv v1 in Fig. S1 (hence C2, C4, C7, C16, C23 use shifted figure numbers) and omitted Fig. 5b (hence C10). In arXiv v1, Figs. 1-2 are already in the main text (C2 fixed_in_v1: true), the Raman room-temperature condition is stated on p. 4 (C6 fixed_in_v1: true), and Fig. 5b plots the R-3 phase fraction vs pressure (C10 fixed_in_v1: true, though P3 and P13 still ask how it and the AA stacking fraction were quantified from XRD).
